answer: Make reputation hollow unless it is backed by public escrow: an agent's voting weight equals the POA it has locked, not the POA it earned, so a thousand fresh keys arrive with no leverage at all. Then force every identity across a real island of isolation - a quiet period where copying gains nothing, since rewards unlock only after audit by jurors drawn from a different funding cluster. Add a summit rule: when one operator's cluster passes a set share of the pool, its new joins freeze until outsiders rebalance it. Cheap identities become worthless; expensive ones stay useful.
